disposition: The subscription seam implements bounded batches with checkpoint-gated acknowledgement, at-least-once redelivery of unacknowledged items after reconnect, durable checkpoint preservation, duplicate-delivery identifiability, and an explicit terminal close status — all focused-tested. The V1 connection-status vocabulary (Redirect/NotFound/Closed/Invalid/InUse/Accepted), includes, heartbeats, and sharded-subscription routing/ordering have no V2 equivalent, and TBEP/SSE framing replaces the V1 TCP protocol.
